what: ADS-B ground fixes of aircraft at SFO in 5 m cells (tools/imagery/adsb_ground_cells.py); cell = [x, z] centre in the world frame (js/geo.js), n = fixes (one per aircraft and cell per 10 s), a = distinct aircraft
licence: ODbL 1.0 - derived from adsb.lol data (https://adsb.lol, ODbL); docs/ATTRIBUTION.md
selection: alt_baro ground, seen_pos <= 2 s, NACp >= 8, aircraft type (not a vehicle pseudo-type) or category A1-A7, < 4 km of the ARP
signal_end_what: close-out round 7: last ground fix (selection above, gs < 3 kt) followed by >= 1800 s with no fresh position fix of that aircraft in the pinned hours: [x, z, hex, type, callsign, t, silent_s]
